scope: Unchanged edge-v1 planar/column gates with qualified isolated model-backed native probes
planar_policy: Four original finite x/y perimeter segments per conductor, duplicates and owners retained; analytic MathEval distances, Min, linear Threshold with .055 mm plateau and inherited transition thickness/near/far; no filled-footprint near-size requirement
cad_policy: One enclosing rectangle object, conductor projections in original order as separate tools; one OCC fragment with complete input/output maps; no fusion, repair or removal
leakage_policy: Exact per-triangle rectangle clipping; round each nonnegative discrepancy upward to a multiple of 2^-80 mm2; aggregate per original conductor against unchanged absolute/relative area tolerance
vertical_policy: Canonical z-only dyadic midpoint/face-band refinement; nominal far spacing; preserve exact stored planes without snapping
condition_policy: Every triangle, sorted global planar node IDs, all three prism templates; exact Frobenius bound at exact retained-height extrema; no rounded rational differences
repeat_rule: Byte-identical complete report and raw planar packet/manifests across fresh local1/repeat1 workers; excludes resource telemetry
infeasible_policy: Retain all reports including failed prospective capacity/condition/volume checks; continue modes unless worker, CAD or planar mesh audit fails
probe_policy: Deterministic endpoints, midpoints, normal plateau/transition/far offsets, oblique endpoint extensions, domain corners and box centers; independently exact segment projection; preserve native distance/size probes before gate, no coordinate snapping
mesh_option_changes: Pin MeshSizeFactor=1 and disable AlgorithmSwitchOnFailure; all other inherited planar mesh options unchanged
probe_adapter_policy: Qualified isolated 0D NodeData adapter; preserve all raw stages and main CAD/fields/options/empty-mesh before/after; exact oracle only under compute guards
